line: Give someone your full attention for one whole conversation.
paragraph: She listened with her body turned toward him, her coffee cooling, her phone face-down on the wobbly table. He talked about the job he lost and the hydrangea cuttings his mother used to root in jars on the windowsill. She asked one quiet question and let the silence hold. He said more than he had planned, then stopped and looked at her. The table was clean except for two rings where the cups had been.
